desc:
🚨 Suit up, grab your gear and answer the call! Patrol the city as Police, Sheriff, SWAT or FBI and handle various hand-built callouts, from street parties and traffic hazards to armed robberies, bomb threats and undercover stings.

👮 4 units, each with its own calls, uniforms, weapons and vehicles
🪪 Talk to every suspect, run their ID, check warrants on the MDT and make the arrest
🚔 Pull drivers over with full traffic stops
🚓 30+ vehicles with working lights and sirens, marked and unmarked
🔓 30+ weapons to unlock in the armory as you rank up
🤝 Team up in squads and work calls together
🌦️ Day and night cycle with live weather
📱 Plays great on phone, tablet, PC and console

🎓 New here? The tutorial walks you through your first shift, from the locker room to your first call, then the Academy teaches you the rest.

⭐ Join the group to stay updated!

Tags: police, cop, roleplay, rp, police simulator, callouts, sheriff, swat, fbi, patrol, traffic stop, police car, siren, emergency
